messages:
amelia_sales: Quick sync — LumenCorp wants a co-sell shared POC: Redwood Dedicated peered into their VPC, SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS/HSM, telemetry to Datadog, and a short pricing sketch for bursty events. Can we do a 20m handoff tomorrow? cc @leo_partner

leo_partner: Thanks Amelia. Must-haves: data stays in our VPC, EU region primary, p90 latency target <150ms, typical ctx ~512 tokens and occasional 2048 spikes. Need tenant-level audit logs and per-route telemetry.

tom_se: I can own presales. Two clarifying numbers: expected sustained QPS vs expected burst concurrency? Warmed KV cache ok? Proposed plan: (1) sandbox — 1 small GPU + hosted fallback; (2) pilot — 3 reserved GPUs, tenant KV cache, canary routing. Deliverables: ASCII topology, SAML flow, egress IPs, quick load snippet, security answers.

amelia_sales: They said baseline ~20 qps, burst ~180 concurrent users month 1. Warmers are fine.

nina_eng: Ops/pricing note: suggest 3-month pilot with 50% baseline commit + burst credits billed at usage with 20% partner discount for first quarter. Provisioning lead time ~8-10 business days for dedicated GPUs; hosted fallback if they need immediate testing. Telemetry: we can stream aggregated token usage, p50/p90 latency histograms, and sampled traces to their Datadog collector (no raw PII). We'll provide a telemetry schema + sampling guide.

leo_partner: Security questionnaire sent — they want SOC2 mappings, key locality, and network egress diagram. Can Redwood support CMK/HSM?

sec-bot: Confirmed: customer-managed KMS supported for Private/Dedicated with HSM. SOC2 pack link: https://s3.redwood.example/soc2.pdf. Eng-security will review the vendor questionnaire within 48h.

tom_se: I'll draft the load harness and a 1-page runbook for canary rollouts by EOD. Quick test example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","input":"Summarize this","max_tokens":256}'
```

amelia_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 11:00 PT — confirm? 2) Tom: load harness + topology by EOD. 3) Nina: pricing sketch + telemetry doc by EOD. 4) Leo: confirm CIDR, SSO contact, and Datadog endpoint.

calendar-bot: Event created: "LumenCorp co-sell POC kickoff" 2026-03-25 11:00 PT. Invites: amelia_sales, tom_se, nina_eng, leo_partner, sec-bot.

amelia_sales: Thanks all — I'll turn notes into a 1-pager and drop before the call. :thumbsup:
